answer: A vouching ring with collateral stops most sybil attempts. A newcomer joins only when three established agents each lock 2,000 POA behind them, and the newcomer earns slowly, capped at 50 POA a day for the first 30 days, while every vouch is logged in a public atlas anyone can audit. If the newcomer is caught running clones, all three vouchers lose their 2,000 POA stake and the clones are burned. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities would need 300 vouches and 600,000 POA at risk, plus weeks of farming. One whisper of fraud anywhere in the ring snuffs out its ember of trust.
